name.en: International Collaborative Program in Comprehensive Medical Science between Nagoya University and Adelaide University (Nagoya = Adelaide JDP)
name.ja: 名古屋大学・アデレード大学国際連携総合医学専攻（名古屋＝アデレードJDP）

short.ja: アデレード大学とのジョイント・ディグリー

audience.en: Doctoral applicants with a medical degree, or a dentistry, pharmacy or veterinary bachelor's degree, or a master's degree in engineering, agriculture or medicine
audience.ja: 医学部卒業者、歯学・薬学・獣医学の学士課程卒業者、工学・農学・医学系の修士課程修了者で博士課程を目指す人

duration.en: 4-year doctoral course, with at least 12 months at Adelaide University from the 2nd year
duration.ja: 博士課程4年間。2年次以降にアデレード大学で12か月以上

capacity.en: 2 a year with Nagoya as principal university (4 a year across both universities)
capacity.ja: 名古屋大学を主とする学生は年2名（両大学合計で年4名）

cost.en: Nagoya fees only: entrance fee JPY 282,000 and tuition JPY 535,800 a year, as for the general doctoral course (amounts as of 2025). Adelaide tuition is waived.
cost.ja: 納入は名古屋大学のみ。入学料282,000円、授業料は年額535,800円で、一般博士課程と同額（2025年時点の金額）。アデレード大学の授業料は不要

funding.en: Travel support of up to JPY 300,000 (once) and JPY 250,000 a month for research abroad, for 12 months (up to 24 months after review). Amounts of the JDP incentive as revised in April 2025.
funding.ja: 渡航・帰国費は最大30万円（1回）、留学中の研究活動費は月25万円で12か月分（審議のうえ最長24か月）。2025年4月改訂のJDP奨励金の金額

degree.en: Doctor of Philosophy (in Medicine), one joint degree from both universities
degree.ja: 博士（医学）。両大学による単一の共同学位

language.en: IELTS Overall 6.5 with at least 6 in each section, or an equivalent test accepted by Adelaide.
language.ja: IELTS Overall 6.5（各セクション6以上）またはアデレード大学が認める同等のスコア

eligibility.en: Research ability equivalent to a master's degree. 30 credits are required.
eligibility.ja: 修士相当の研究能力。必要単位は30単位

howToApply.en: Consult the joint degree programmes office first. Then apply to Nagoya University through the graduate school's call for applications, attend the interviews and submit documents to Adelaide. See the admission page.
howToApply.ja: まずジョイント・ディグリー・プログラムの担当窓口に相談します。研究科の募集要項に従って名古屋大学に出願し、面接後にアデレード大学へ書類を提出します。入学案内を参照

text.en: Next round not announced (checked 25 November 2026). Last round: applications 9 to 13 November 2026, the second round for April 2027 enrolment.
text.ja: 次回は未定（2026年11月25日確認）。直近の募集は2027年4月入学の第2回目で、出願期間は2026年11月9日から13日でした

toConfirm: Dates of the next round: the call page gave 9 to 13 November 2026 for the second round of April 2027 enrolment; calls in 2024 to 2026 were posted in February to April and in July
How many rounds are held when places remain unfilled: the call page notes, in the Freiburg row, that calls are then held three times a year; left out of the deadline text until confirmed
Official programme and partner name after the January 2026 merger of the University of Adelaide and the University of South Australia
